    "ROLE" CHARACTER VARYING(50) DEFAULT 'USER'
);

CREATE CACHED TABLE "PUBLIC"."HINT_USAGE_LOG"(
    "ID" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY(START WITH 1 RESTART WITH 33) NOT NULL,
    "HINT_TYPE" CHARACTER VARYING(255),
    "TIMESTAMP" TIMESTAMP,
    "SESSION_NUMBER" INTEGER,
    "USER_ID" BIGINT,
    "PROBLEM_ID" BIGINT
);

CREATE CACHED TABLE "PUBLIC"."SUBMISSION"(
    "ID" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY(START WITH 1 RESTART WITH 321) NOT NULL,
    "CODE" CHARACTER LARGE OBJECT,
    "SESSION_NUMBER" INTEGER,
    "HINTS_USED" INTEGER,
    "SCORE" INTEGER,
    "SUCCESS" BOOLEAN,
    "OUTPUT" CHARACTER VARYING(255),
    "ON_TASK_TIME" BIGINT,
    "OFF_TASK_TIME" BIGINT,
    "SUBMITTED_AT" TIMESTAMP,
    "USER_ID" BIGINT,
    "PROBLEM_ID" BIGINT,
    "HINT_COUNTS" CHARACTER VARYING(255),
    "HINT_LEVEL_CAP" CHARACTER VARYING(32) DEFAULT NULL,
    "FAILED_RUNS" INTEGER
);          
ALTER TABLE "PUBLIC"."SUBMISSION" ADD CONSTRAINT "PUBLIC"."CONSTRAINT_A" PRIMARY KEY("ID");   
-- 0 +/- SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PUBLIC.SUBMISSION;              
ALTER TABLE "PUBLIC"."SUBMISSION" ADD CONSTRAINT "PUBLIC"."FK_SUB_USER" FOREIGN KEY("USER_ID") REFERENCES "PUBLIC"."APP_USER"("ID") NOCHECK;  
ALTER TABLE "PUBLIC"."SUBMISSION" ADD CONSTRAINT "PUBLIC"."FK_SUB_PROB" FOREIGN KEY("PROBLEM_ID") REFERENCES "PUBLIC"."PROBLEM"("ID") NOCHECK;
